text: ZX81 WEATHER WALL 10 OCT 21:05Z (DATA 3 HOURS OLD). ALERT: TORNADO WARNING IN SOUTH CAROLINA; FLASH FLOOD WARNING IN GEORGIA, SOUTH CAROLINA; HIGH WIND WARNING IN RUSSIA, GERMANY; HEAVY RAIN WARNING IN GERMANY, ITALY, SAUDI ARABIA, GREECE, BELARUS, MONTENEGRO; SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING IN NIGERIA, ITALY, ECUADOR, GREECE, CROATIA; MAJOR HURRICANE SIGNATURE SIMON 938MB C AMERICA; MAJOR HURRICANE SIGNATURE KOGUMA 942MB W PACIFIC; 1 MAJOR FIRE PORTEL; HOT NIGHT 28C MUMBAI, 26C LAGOS, 25C ABIDJAN; TROPICAL NIGHT 23C SANTO DOMING, 21C BENGALURU, 21C CASABLANCA +2 MORE. 100 ZX81S ON WATCH.

image.alt: A 10x10 wall of 100 ZX81 screens rendering a live world weather map in 1-bit block graphics. Alerts: tornado warning SOUTH CAROLINA; flash flood warning GEORGIA, SOUTH CAROLINA; high wind warning RUSSIA, GERMANY; heavy rain warning GERMANY, ITALY, SAUDI ARABIA, GREECE, BELARUS, MONTENEGRO; severe thunderstorm warning NIGERIA, ITALY, ECUADOR, GREECE, CROATIA; SIMON 938MB C AMERICA, KOGUMA 942MB W PACIFIC; sweltering night N INDIA 28C, W AFRICA 26C, TROP ATL 25C; 1 major fire: PORTEL; hot night N ATLANTIC 23C, E ATLANTIC 21C, S INDIA 21C, E PACIFIC 20C, N AFRICA 20C; drought emergency EUROPE, W AFRICA (GDACS). Hottest 34C at BRASILIA, coldest 7C at REYKJAVIK. Precipitation: rain areas and snow or wintry areas. Roughest seas at S PACIFIC. Notable: smoky, unhealthy air over E ASIA. 6 further wildfires burning.
